keep.text: Aap logon ne bachpan se ekdam galat seekha hai, ekdam ulta.
Pata hai kya?
Ki breakfast is the most important meal.
Aur ye sarasar ekdam jhooth hai.
Aapko kisne batayi ye cheez? Aapke mummy papa ne?
Aapke dada dadi ne?
Koi doctor ne, koi scientist ne?
Kisne bataya?
1944 mein ek cereal company ne
isko ek marketing campaign ki tarah use kiya tha,
ki breakfast is the most important meal
of the whole day.
Kyun? Kyunki aap log raat bhar fast rehte ho, toh phir breakfast karna is most important. Kyun? Kyunki unka cereal bik sake zyada se zyada.
Harvard ke ek professor David Sinclair ne 25 saal research ki anti-aging pe,
aur unka kehna tha, breakfast is not the most important meal in the day.
David kehte hain ki jab hum hamesha khaate rehte hain, teen se chaar meal
din ke, plus snacks kha lete hain, toh aapki body mein ek pathway on ho jaata hai jiska naam hai mTOR. mTOR ka matlab hota hai Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin.
Aur ye ek growth signal hai,
aur cells isko
divide karti rehti hain,
aur DNA isi ko copy karte rehte hain, toh har copy mein breaks aate hain,
breaks se epigenome bigadta hai, aur epigenome bigda
toh aging aapki fast ho jaati hai.
Lekin jab aap log nahi khaate ho, fast hai toh, toh doosra pathway on ho jaata hai jiska naam hai AMPK. AMPK yaani ki activated
protein
kinase.
Ab AMPK kya karta hai?
Sirtuins naam ke 7 anti-aging enzymes ko activate kar deta hai.
Ye enzymes DNA repair karte hain aur
epigenome stable rakhte hain, aur isi kaaran se aapki aging slow ho jaati hai.
Matlab har baar aap khaana khaate ho,
body aapki boodhi ho rahi hai zyada khaana khaane se.
Aur har baar aap jab fast rehte ho, toh zyada time tak aapki body chal paayegi.
Zyada fast rehne se
kam aging hoti hai, bhookhe rehne se.
Meri sabse badi galti yahi thi, maine din mein 5 se 6 baar khaana khaaya. Bhale thoda thoda thoda khaaya, magar 5 se 6 baar khaaya.
5 se 6 baar khaana khaane se metabolism badhta hai, aisa logon ne bola tha mujhe, toh mujhe laga ki yaar aisa hota hoga.
But aisa nahi hota, ye poora ka poora jhooth hai. Jab aap fasting shuru karte hain 16:8 ki, yaani ki intermittent fasting ki, phir uske baad 18:6 ki,
toh is tareeke se
aap log apni body ka khayal rakh paate ho. Jitni der tak aap apna pet khaali rakhoge, pet apne aapko repair karega, body apne aapko repair karegi. Isi ko kehte hain autophagy.
110 se 85 kilo tak aaya hoon main. Biological age meri 23 se 24 hai,
jabki meri
actual age 35 hai. Meri body ki age jo hai wo
24 ke around hai.
Yaani ki aaj meri passport age
35 saal se
24 tak ke beech mein 11 saal ka difference hai.

Fasting ka poora ka poora protocol, kab khaana hai, kab nahi khaana hai, kitna khaana hai, kya khaana hai, aur kaise shuru karna hai, ye saari cheezein maine apne health protocol mein daal ke rakhi hui hain,
aur wo bhi step by step.
Main ye nahi keh raha hoon ki khaana khaana band hi kar do.
Main ye bhi nahi keh raha hoon ki sirf paani peejiye.
But water fasting ko try karna aapka banta hai.
Toh mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer, milte hain
next video mein!
